title: Unnamed Adventure/无名之旅
description:
Check out this game!

Об игреPatch Note V1.1Reduce game difficulty, increase player view, and fix various bugs.CombatEnjoy a pixel precise, skilled based combat system. Where you have to pay full attention to enemy's move, and choose best action accordingly. Unlock a variety of skills to improve your combat moves as well.
Include 38 unique enemy types, 15 boss/mini boss fights.

Puzzles and PlatformingAs you progress through the game, you will discover new abilities to solve different small puzzles over the map, find new upgrade items, materials to craft new runes to help you conquer your enemies.Story and LoreAn dark, rich story hidden behind items and conversation, discover it alone your journey!Asset CreditThis project cannot be done without these people!

description_short: Unnamed Adventure, an indie action platformer where every single level, puzzle is crafted by hands. Wander around in a mysterious kingdom where surprise and finding may hide in every corner you visit.
